CheckTitle: OBS buckets have default server-side encryption enabled
Description: Ensure that OBS buckets have default server-side encryption configured so newly uploaded objects are encrypted at rest by default.
Risk: Without default server-side encryption, new objects are not guaranteed to be encrypted unless each upload explicitly requests encryption. This weakens data-at-rest protection and encryption governance.

Code.Other:
1. Log on to the Huawei Cloud console.
2. Navigate to Object Storage Service.
3. Select the bucket.
4. Open the server-side encryption settings.
5. Enable SSE-OBS (AES-256) or SSE-KMS as required.
6. Save the configuration.

Recommendation.Text: Enable default server-side encryption for all OBS buckets. Use SSE-OBS (AES-256) when OBS-managed keys are appropriate, or SSE-KMS when customer-managed key control and auditability are required.
